messages:
sana: Heads up — customers are seeing a ~15% 5xx spike after the 10:20 UTC rollout. Spike starts right when the new route-propagation toggle was enabled for canary traffic. :eyes:

alex: Which errors specifically? 502/503/gateway timeouts? Any common customer ids?

sana: Mostly 502 and intermittent 504 timeouts. Support ticket RT-4312 had a reproducible example. Error traces show gateway drops when requests are routed to variant B.

morgan: I pulled a sample trace from Kibana:
```
trace_id: d9f8a1
service: api-gateway
error: upstream_reset
upstream: inference-host-b
note: auth header missing on upstream request
```
Looks like auth propagation broke for that route.

riya: Oh — the feature toggle changed the header forwarding logic. We shipped a short-circuit that rewrites/omits Authorization when route-propagation-v2 is active. I thought we guarded it, but maybe the canary config targeted the wrong tag.

alex: Can we repro locally? jordan, can you share a quick curl that fails?

jordan: repro with a real customer token (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hi"}'
```
On variant A (old path) we see 200. On variant B we see: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway and gateway logs show upstream without Authorization header.

riya: Confirmed. The canary selector accidentally matched services with a routing flag graph that strips headers for legacy reasons. The toggle was scoped by tag 'region-eu' but we intended 'region-eu-test'. Sigh.

sana: Support: customers reporting timeouts and failing requests. Billing might be affected if retries increase. Need coordinated rollback.

morgan: Plan: 1) set canary weight to 0, 2) revert toggle in config-store, 3) monitor for 5xx drop and customer confirmations. Who can flip weight now?

alex: Ops-bot runbook check: @ops-bot can you execute set-weight? :pray:

ops-bot: runbook:rollback-canary v1 invoked by alex at 10:36 UTC. Executing: set_traffic_weight --route route-propagation-v2 --weight 0
ops-bot: command output: SUCCESS. New traffic allocation: variant A 100%, variant B 0%.

riya: Also removed the mis-scoped tag from the toggle config: `kvstore:update feature-toggle:route-propagation-v2 --remove-target region-eu`

jordan: Metrics: 2m after the weight flip 5xx rate drops from 15% -> 1.2% on hosted-api. Latency median unaffected.

sana: Support update sent to impacted customers with ETA and apology. Asking for any retained logs/timestamps so we can correlate.

morgan: Postmortem notes to include: mis-scoped toggle target, lack of automated pre-deploy header regression test, and an ops guard to confirm header-fwd behavior when toggles flip.

alex: For next steps: add a small integration test that runs a tokened request across all route variants in CI; add a preflight for toggle rollouts that checks header propagation; follow up with oncall to confirm rollback is stable.

riya: I'll open the PRs for test+guard. jordan please attach the failing trace & sample request to the ticket.

jordan: Done — attached logs and curl snippet to RT-4312.

sana: Closing thread once support confirms customers OK and SRE sees stable 5xx below baseline for 30m. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
